title: The final check's faults keep why they failed, masked, in the chain's write diagnostics
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: The final check's faults keep a masked reason, up to sixty taken in turn by group, inside the size bound; no secret, path or address reaches the diagnostics.

tests: a failed final check retains fault identities and skipped repairs without private prose
the final check keeps up to sixty faults taken in turn by group, each with why it failed, within the size bound
